about: PAR-INFRA-13: how each vanilla block of vanilla-shapes-<version>.json may serve as a hitbox carrier. presence: absent = never in a TFC world (usable as is); natural = occurs in TFC worlds or our worldgen places it (usable only with a one-hop hide mapping); player = players craft or place it in TFC (never usable); reserved = kept for another family, or a worldgen placeholder with no hide target (PAR-INFRA-42, mud by PAR-INFRA-43; CarrierPolicyWorldgenTest checks absent against paper/worldgen; an absent block our worldgen places in known states lists those states in excluded_states, PAR-INFRA-43 buttons); reference = dumped for comparison only. only_class: the one shape class that may use the block (reserved by its class override); every other class rejects it. Every dumped block must be listed here or in hard_ban. replaceable_only: the states that are really replaceable when the dump's flag (BlockState.canBeReplaced(), the material flag) is wider: SnowLayerBlock lets any other item replace only layers=1 (a held snow layer adds a layer to any count below 8, see the snow notes in the item).

minecraft:snow.note: TFC snowfall places vanilla snow layers 1-8; real instances of a used layer count are sent as the nearest unused count

minecraft:light_weighted_pressure_plate.note: PAR-INFRA-44: TFC keeps the vanilla recipe (2 minecraft:gold_ingot; its data/minecraft/recipe neither removes nor overrides it) and PAR-PROC-03 lets kept vanilla recipes craft on vanilla items; vanilla gold comes from the Nether (nether gold ore, piglins, bastions), so with the Nether on players craft and place it. Never a carrier: its unpressed 14x1x14 box is the heavy plate's, which serves with a hide
